threads.title: Start here: how to ask so the cohort can help

posts.body:
Say the number, what you tried and where you’re stuck.

Keep it to one question a thread, so the next team can find it.

threads.title: Our bookkeeper keeps the QuickBooks login. Can the operator still connect the books?

posts.body:
Step 6 asks us to connect the books. Our bookkeeper keeps the login and won’t share it.

Is an export enough for now?

Yes. An export is the yellow route on your stack card.

Put your bookkeeper on the card as the person who has it, and send the card back.
Same here. We asked ours for an export each month and that was fine.
